url.title: Endpoint URL
url.description: Your Azure OpenAI deployment chat completions URL, including api-version. Example: https://{resource}.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/{deployment}/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Azure OpenAI resource API key.

is_stream.title: Enable streaming
is_stream.description: Enables data streaming when supported by the model. When true, responses are processed in chunks for immediate delivery. Default is false.

timeout.title: HTTP Timeout
timeout.description: The maximum time, in seconds, to wait for a response from the server before the request is canceled.

request_format.title: Request Format
request_format.description: Sample Request Format. For Azure OpenAI the model is implied by the deployment in the URL.
